mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right bathroom remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a contractor with the right license, insurance, and a track record of bathroom work similar to your project. Ask for recent local references, examples of finished bathrooms, and a detailed written scope of work. The best contractor is not just the lowest bid; it is the one who explains the process clearly and gives you a complete, realistic estimate.
